gloss: to be inferior, to fall behind

definitions.gloss: to be inferior to, to be worse than
definitions.explanation: To be of lower quality or ability than something else.

examples.japanese: どちらも{劣|おと}らず{素晴|すば}らしい。

notes:
{劣|おと}る means to be inferior.

PATTERNS:
- 〜に{劣|おと}る: to be inferior to ~
- 〜に{劣|おと}らず: not inferior to ~
- {勝|まさ}るとも{劣|おと}らない: at least as good as

OPPOSITE:
- {優|すぐ}れる: to excel, be superior
- {勝|まさ}る: to surpass
